models.tools.chunkerDetail: Runs in-process. Whether it runs at all is the Text pipeline’s ceiling.
models.tools.vectorIndexPurpose: The search indexes recall depends on. Rebuild any row whose recorded state has drifted from the database.
models.tools.colStoredHint: What config.json records as this space's index state — checked against the live “In the database” state to surface drift.
models.tools.driftTitle: {{count}} space(s) claim a ready index the database does not have.
models.tools.driftBody: Recall in those spaces returns nothing and reports no error. Rebuild the index with the button on the row to fix it.
models.tools.indexEmpty: No spaces with their own indexes.
models.modeDesc.off: Documents are stored but never read. No text is extracted, so nothing from them can be recalled.
models.modeDesc.ocr: The OCR sidecar (Tesseract) reads text and tables from each page. Fast, fully local, no vision model needed.
models.modeDesc.vlm: Render each page and transcribe it with the vision model, grounded on the OCR text.
models.modeDesc.repair: VLM, plus a repair pass that reconciles the draft against the OCR text — and a second-model consensus pass when a verify model is set.
models.modeDesc.auto: As much as this instance can do: the repair pass when a repair model is configured, otherwise the vision model, otherwise OCR.
models.docSummary.off: Not read at all — documents are stored but never analysed
models.docSummary.fallback: Mode is {{mode}}, but no vision model — falls back to OCR
models.docSummary.repaired: Read by {{mode}} — OCR-grounded {{model}} vision, repaired against OCR
models.confirm.egressTitle: Send document content to an external model?
models.confirm.egressMessage: The model at {{host}} will receive document content — OCR-extracted text and draft transcriptions, and rendered page images for image-based tasks. This data leaves your instance and is subject to that provider’s handling. Enable egress to {{host}}?
models.confirm.reindexTitle: Change the embedding model — re-index everything?
models.confirm.reindexMessage: Changing the embedding model, dimensions, or similarity means every stored vector in every space must be RE-EMBEDDED. Recall is degraded until it finishes, and on a large instance this can take a long while. Only continue if you understand what you are doing.
models.confirm.discardMessage: You have unsaved changes on this tab. Switching tabs discards them.
models.pipelines.ceilingHint: The most any space may do with this class. A space can choose less, never more — lowering this caps every space already above it, and those spaces keep their own choice if you raise it again.
models.pipelines.ceilingOffWarning: Off applies everywhere — no space can process this class.
files.progress.stalled: No progress reported — this job may be stuck
models.face.enable: Detect and embed faces in uploaded images
models.face.enableHint: Off by default. Requires the local model files to be present.
models.face.confidenceHint: Similarity (0–1) above which a face is labelled automatically. Below it the face is embedded but left unlabelled.
models.face.minSizeHint: As a fraction of the image’s shorter side. Smaller faces are skipped, which avoids noise from crowd shots.
models.face.personTypesHint: Chosen from your Schema Library entity types. Only entities of these types can enter the face gallery, so linking a location or object to a photo can never poison it.
models.face.personTypesEmpty: No entity types in your Schema Library yet — define some there to select them here.
models.confirm.faceOffMessage:
No new faces will be detected or embedded from this point on.

Existing face vectors and person labels are NOT removed — they stay stored and searchable until the files they came from are deleted. Turning this off is not the same as erasing what has already been collected.
spaces.schema.propertySchemasHint: — the properties this type declares; how strictly they are enforced follows the validation setting above
